selection_rationale: The 12 pre-registered seed-0 scenarios had no initial nontraining joint-marked candidate. Training seed 1 is the second sequential pre-registered batch. Scenario selection did not read a global optimum or any nontraining true ED/LP cost. This is not formal and is not evidence of quantum advantage. Only discovery of initial_nontraining_joint_marked_count > 0 can justify considering a later Grover pilot.
